newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina approves troops for Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Argentina approves troops for Zaire.

text.p: Argentina on Friday approved the dispatch of 60 soldiers as part of a United Nations-endorsed multinational force to help refugees in eastern Zaire.
Defence Minister Jorge Dominguez and Joint Forces chief Vice-Admiral Jorge Enrico said the light infrantrymen will be sent within two weeks.

Earlier neighbouring Brazil said it would send up to 150 soldiers to join the U.N. intervention force in eastern Zaire, a spokesman for President Fernando Henrique Cardoso said. No date has yet been set for their departure.
The Canadian-led U.N. force is to provide relief to refugees still in eastern Zaire. Canada said the mission would continue despite a mass return of Rwandan refugees from Zaire.
